```{r}
prepare_data_files <- function() {
  setwd("data")  # Change to the data directory
  # Check if the required data files are present
  required_files <- c("202507-divvy-tripdata.csv")

  download_urls <- c("https://divvy-tripdata.s3.amazonaws.com/202507-divvy-tripdata.zip")
  for (i in required_files) {
    if (!file.exists(i)) {
      print(paste("Missing file:", i))
      print(paste("Downloading from:", download_urls[i]))
      target_file_name <- paste0("data_", i, ".zip")
      download.file(download_urls[i], destfile = target_file_name, mode = "wb")
      print(paste("Extracting:", target_file_name))
      unzip(target_file_name, exdir = ".")
      print(paste("Extracted:", target_file_name))
      file.remove(target_file_name)  # Clean up the zip file after extraction
    } else {
      print("All required data files are present.")
    }
  }
}

prepare_data_files()

```
